Daily soil moisture at Balruddery in 2019

Source: R/data.R
balruddery_2019.Rd

Daily volumetric soil water content from the COSMOS-UK monitoring station at Balruddery, near Dundee. The extract contains all 365 daily records for station BALRD in 2019. Contains data supplied by UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology.

Usage

data(balruddery_2019)

Format

A data frame with 365 rows and two columns:

  • date: observation date as a Date.

  • vwc: volumetric soil water content, expressed as a percentage.

Source

Stanley et al. (2026), Daily and sub-daily hydrometeorological and soil moisture data (2013–2025) (COSMOS-UK), NERC EDS Environmental Information Data Centre. Data catalogue. Open Government Licence v3.

Examples

data("balruddery_2019", package = "naboer")
head(balruddery_2019)
#>         date  vwc
#> 1 2019-01-01 33.3
#> 2 2019-01-02 31.5
#> 3 2019-01-03 33.4
#> 4 2019-01-04 34.4
#> 5 2019-01-05 33.8
#> 6 2019-01-06 33.4
